newsitem.title: USA: Galey & Lord Q3 hurt by $0.10/shr charge.
newsitem.headline: Galey & Lord Q3 hurt by $0.10/shr charge.

text.p: Galey & Lord Inc said Wednesday income for the third quarter was hurt by a $0.10 per share after-tax bad debt reserve taken as a result of a major home fabrics customer filing for bankruptcy protection.
The company also said its order backlog when the quarter ended was $139 million, a 51 percent increase from the prior year backlog of $92 million.
Excluding the charge, earnings for the quarter would have been $0.45 per share compared with $0.34 for the same period last year.
The company reported earnings per share of $0.35.
The company also said apparel fabrics backlog was up 71 percent and is at record seasonal levels.
Home fabrics order backlog was down 32 percent from the prior year primarily due to the customer's bankruptcy.
The company said it continues to sell to the home fabrics customer that filed for bankruptcy protection and that is now operating as a debtor-in-possession.
However, Galey & Lord now books orders for that customer only upon receipt of cash deposits.
